This filing has no recognizable section headers, only flowing prose that talks about the business and its operations and prospects without any formal Item structure at all. It might happen with very old filings or with reformatted exhibit attachments. The parser should still produce a single section so the rest of the pipeline can chunk and embed it.

Additional paragraph of body text to ensure the fallback section is non-trivial in length and that the parser does not silently drop content that lacks an Item structure. The pipeline must remain useful even when the filing's own structure is absent.
